title: Mixed-occupancy warehouse fire-resistance ratings (Council Order 0015443)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The project was a proposed two-storey, multi-bay F2 medium-hazard industrial warehouse containing D and F3 tenant occupancies.
The appellant proposed reducing the second-storey floor/fire-separation and supporting walls/columns from two-hour to 45-minute fire resistance based on tenant rather than base-building occupancy.
The order reproduces ABC 2006 requirements and records the parties’ competing interpretations of how the most-restricted base-building occupancy and tenant occupancy interact.
